sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:223

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:223:1
items.html: Atik of Beria is the point of Malchut of Atzilut. This was already explained above, page 1979, the passage beginning “And at first glance.” And it will be further explained below, page 2012, the passage beginning “The GAR.”

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:223:2
items.html: And is clothed like the GAR of the VAK of AA, which are the revealed HGT. It was already explained above, in the adjacent item, that these HGT of AA came to Beria only in the discernment of a garment of the NHY of Atik, and therefore they now also became a garment for Atik of Beria. See there.
